2609.02885.title: Discriminative World Models for Web Agents
2609.02885.paper_summary: Recent web agents use world models for test-time action selection by sampling candidate actions, predicting the resulting web states, and ranking them with a ranker model or a Process Reward Model (PRM). These world models are typically trained via supervised next-state prediction to generate fixed representations like HTML or AXTree snapshots. However, this objective is misaligned with the downstream ranker, which relies on predicted states being discriminative across candidates to accurately score them. To address this, we introduce predicted-state matching, a training objective where the predicted representation must distinguish the true resulting state from those reached by alternative actions. We train these models using a branching web-agent dataset derived from WebArena Go-Browse trajectories, where every decision point contains multiple alternative actions and their resulting states. Experiments on our held-out predicted-state matching benchmark show that our approach outperforms world models trained with supervised next-state prediction. We further show that our approach improves PRM-style action ranking on WebPRMBench compared with action-only PRMs and PRMs augmented with supervised-next-state world models. Finally, on WebArena-Lite, using our world model for test-time action selection improves end-to-end task success. Our project page is available at: https://dhruvpendharkar.github.io/dwm/.
2609.02885.paper_summary_zh: 最近的網路代理使用世界模型進行測試時的行動選擇，通過抽樣候選行動、預測結果網路狀態，並使用排名模型或過程獎勵模型（PRM）對其進行排名。這些世界模型通常通過監督式的下一狀態預測進行訓練，以生成固定的表示，如HTML或AXTree快照。然而，這一目標與下游排名器不一致，因為下游排名器依賴於預測狀態在候選之間具有區分性，以準確評分。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了預測狀態匹配，這是一個訓練目標，其中預測的表示必須區分真實的結果狀態與其他行動所達到的狀態。我們使用從WebArena Go-Browse軌跡衍生的分支網路代理數據集來訓練這些模型，其中每個決策點包含多個替代行動及其結果狀態。在我們的保留預測狀態匹配基準上的實驗顯示，我們的方法優於使用監督式下一狀態預測訓練的世界模型。我們進一步顯示，與僅行動的PRM和增強了監督式下一狀態世界模型的PRM相比，我們的方法在WebPRMBench上改善了PRM風格的行動排名。最後，在WebArena-Lite上，使用我們的世界模型進行測試時的行動選擇改善了端到端任務成功率。我們的項目頁面可在以下網址找到：https://dhruvpendharkar.github.io/dwm/.
